function.name: get_deployment_30day_query_counts
function.description: Get the aggregate query count over the last 30 days for multiple subgraph deployments, sorted by query count in descending order.

function.name: search_subgraphs_by_keyword
function.description: Search for subgraphs by keyword in their display names, ordered by signal. Returns top 10 results if total results ≤ 100, or square root of total otherwise.

keyword.description: Keyword to search for in subgraph names
